segments.en: So a step in the right direction, is it a durable step, a long term step, or is this just, you know, they're taking the advantage of what right now is just kind of a crazy market?

segments.en: Let's put it in perspective. So if I'm saying they're getting about a 1% return on assets, their borrowing cost has actually just gone up. It was closer to 8% and now it's close to 10%.
segments.zh: 客观来看，资产回报率约1%，而借贷成本已从8%升至接近10%。

segments.en: So you're borrowing at 10% to get a 1% return. That's not good news. So again, they have to improve the returns very significantly. And that's reduced the cost to capital, which recently
segments.zh: 以10%的成本借入资金，却只获得1%的回报，这并非好消息。

segments.en: has actually gone the wrong way. That's why we're questioning the whole category is that this is like borrowing on margin to buy treasuries, borrowing a 10% to buy a 5% return isn't a good idea.
segments.zh: 因此，整个类别受到质疑，就像用保证金买国债，借10%去赚5%并不明智。
